places.name: Crown & Coils Studio
places.description: A calm, bright studio for natural hair. Known for neat knotless braids, loc retwists and wash-and-go styling, with a separate corner for kids.

places.name: The Fade Room
places.description: A classic barbershop with a modern edge. Precision fades, beard sculpting and hot towel shaves, with Afrobeats always on.

places.name: Adunni Beauty Lounge
places.description: A full-service beauty lounge for owambe and bridal glam: wig installs, lashes, makeup and gele tying, all in one visit.

places.name: Polished Nail Bar
places.description: A small, spotless nail bar with a long list of gel colours and patient technicians who take nail art seriously.

places.name: Kinks & Twists
places.description: Affordable braiding close to the Yaba tech corridor. Popular with students, so book ahead on Fridays and Saturdays.

places.name: Sharp Edge Barbers
places.description: A busy neighbourhood barbershop with quick service, fair prices and match-day banter.

places.name: Glow Haven Spa & Salon
places.description: Part spa, part salon. Unwind with a deep-tissue massage or facial while your treatment sets.

places.name: Mama Tee's Kitchen
places.description: A no-frills buka serving some of the best amala and ewedu in Yaba. Arrive before 1 PM or queue with the lunch crowd.

places.name: Ember & Smoke Grill
places.description: A lively grill house with open flames, suya-spiced everything and a cocktail bar that stays busy past midnight at weekends.

places.name: The Jollof Co.
places.description: Smoky party jollof, cooked the way it is at weddings. Pair it with peppered turkey and a generous side of dodo.

places.name: Buka Republic
places.description: A clean, fast canteen for Ikeja office workers. Pounded yam and egusi, ofada rice with ayamase, and a proper Nigerian breakfast from 7 AM.

places.name: Terra Kitchen
places.description: Contemporary Nigerian fine dining. Seasonal tasting menus reinvent classics like ofe owerri and asun with fine-dining technique.

places.name: Suya Spot
places.description: The smoke tells you you're close. Beef suya, chicken and kilishi, freshly grilled from evening into the early hours.

places.name: Harbour Plates
places.description: A big, breezy dining room with a seafood-heavy menu. Good for group lunches and slow weekend brunch.

places.name: MedCare Pharmacy
places.description: A round-the-clock pharmacy with licensed pharmacists on every shift, free blood pressure checks and same-day delivery in Lekki.

places.name: Wellspring Pharmacy
places.description: A friendly, well-stocked pharmacy that accepts most HMOs. Also offers travel vaccinations and a dermatologist-picked skincare range.

places.name: CityCure Pharmacy
places.description: An always-open Opebi landmark with a small diagnostics corner for malaria and blood sugar tests, and a large baby-care aisle.

places.name: Greenleaf Chemist
places.description: A compact neighbourhood chemist for everyday medicines, first-aid supplies and quick advice from the pharmacist.

places.name: Ikoyi Health Pharmacy
places.description: Private consultation rooms, repeat-prescription management for chronic conditions and a good range of vitamins and supplements.

places.name: Surulere Family Pharmacy
places.description: A family-run pharmacy that has served Surulere households for over a decade. They know their regulars by name.

places.name: Maryland Meds
places.description: A 24-hour pharmacy on Ikorodu Road with drive-by pickup for pre-ordered prescriptions, so you don't need to park.

places.name: Bean There Café
places.description: Yaba's unofficial co-working space. Fast Wi-Fi, plenty of sockets, backup power and a cold brew worth the trip.

places.name: Kofi & Crumbs
places.description: A bakery café where the croissants come out of the oven every morning. The chin-chin-crusted banana bread sells out by noon.

places.name: The Roastery
places.description: A specialty roaster brewing single-origin Nigerian and Ethiopian beans. Grab a pour-over and a bag of freshly roasted beans.

places.name: Garden Brew
places.description: A café in a plant-filled courtyard, green in the middle of VI. Good for long brunches and afternoon smoothies.

places.name: Crumb & Co. Bakery
places.description: Hot meat pies, sausage rolls and celebration cakes to order. An early-morning favourite on Toyin Street.

places.name: Latte Lane
places.description: A cosy neighbourhood café with excellent latte art, good toasties and a quiet upstairs room for studying.

places.name: Morning Pour
places.description: Built for the commute: open from 6:30 AM with a drive-through window and iced coffee ready in two minutes.

places.name: FreshMart Lekki
places.description: A large supermarket with a great fresh produce section, an in-store bakery and plenty of parking. Delivery in 90 minutes across Lekki.

places.name: Island Grocers
places.description: The go-to spot on the island for imported pantry staples, a good wine selection and a deli counter with fresh cold cuts.

places.name: Daily Needs Supermarket
places.description: Everything for the monthly shopping run: bulk rice and oil, household essentials and provisions at prices that beat the open market.

places.name: Ikoyi Pantry
places.description: A boutique grocer with organic produce from farms in Ogun and Oyo, an in-house butcher and a well-labelled free-from aisle.

places.name: ValuePlus Mart
places.description: Budget-friendly aisles with frozen food, toiletries and weekly deals posted by the entrance.

places.name: Gbagada Groceries
places.description: A tidy neighbourhood supermarket for quick top-up shops: fresh bread, cold drinks and all the basics.

places.name: Ajah Superstore
places.description: A large-format store on the expressway with groceries, small appliances and a big fresh produce hall. Easy parking.

places.name: IronWorks Gym
places.description: A serious strength gym with calibrated plates, deadlift platforms and coaches who program for powerlifting and hypertrophy.

places.name: Pulse Fitness Club
places.description: A premium club with a packed class timetable, from spin and HIIT to dance cardio, followed by the sauna and steam room.

places.name: Body Lab Ikeja
places.description: A well-equipped mainland gym offering monthly body-composition scans so you can track progress beyond the mirror.

places.name: Yaba Strength Co.
places.description: A community box with daily group workouts, Olympic lifting clinics and a whiteboard leaderboard to compete on.

places.name: Skyline Wellness
places.description: A light-filled studio for reformer Pilates, yoga and recovery sessions, with floor-to-ceiling views over the city.

places.name: Sweat Box Surulere
places.description: A no-nonsense gym with affordable memberships, a boxing ring and evening circuit classes that fill up fast.

places.name: FitHub 24/7
places.description: Train whenever suits you. Key-card access around the clock, with staffed hours from 6 AM to 10 PM.

places.name: Zuri Hair Atelier
places.description: A bright, unhurried studio for natural hair. Known for knotless braids, silk presses and loc maintenance, with stylists who take their time over consultations.

places.name: Capital Cuts Barbershop
places.description: A busy neighbourhood barbershop for clean fades, beard shaping and quick walk-ins. Expect a short queue on Saturday mornings.

places.name: Maitama Glow Spa
places.description: A quiet day spa off Gana Street offering facials, massages and full bridal glam. Book ahead for weekend appointments.

places.name: Lash & Brow Lab
places.description: Specialists in lash extensions, brow lamination and microblading, a short walk from Jabi Lake.

places.name: Area 11 Braid Bar
places.description: Affordable braids, twists and cornrows done quickly by a team of experienced braiders. Bring your own extensions or buy them here.

places.name: The Gentleman's Chair
places.description: An upscale grooming lounge with hot-towel shaves, beard treatments and a calm waiting area with good coffee.

places.name: Nail Nook
places.description: A cosy nail bar on 1st Avenue for gel manicures, acrylics and pedicures. Walk-ins are welcome most weekdays.

places.name: Arewa Grill House
places.description: Northern Nigerian grills done properly: suya, balangu and whole grilled fish, served with yaji, sliced onions and cold zobo.

places.name: Mama Hauwa's Kitchen
places.description: A lunchtime favourite for tuwo shinkafa with miyan kuka, masa and pepper soup. Portions are generous and prices are fair.

places.name: Lakeside Bistro
places.description: Relaxed all-day dining near Jabi Lake, with jollof, grilled chicken and pasta, and a long brunch menu at weekends.

places.name: Pepper Soup Palace
places.description: An after-work spot for goat meat and catfish pepper soup, asun and cold drinks. Busiest after 7 PM.

places.name: The Maitama Table
places.description: Modern Nigerian cooking as a tasting menu in a converted Maitama villa. Reservations are recommended, and the smoked jollof is a must.

places.name: Suya Junction
places.description: Late-night suya straight off the grill, sliced to order and wrapped with extra yaji and onions. Worth the wait.

places.name: Ofada & Co.
places.description: Ofada rice with ayamase, efo riro, and amala with gbegiri and ewedu, cooked the way it's done at home.

places.name: Capital Care Pharmacy
places.description: Open around the clock, with a pharmacist always on duty and a well-stocked baby and skincare aisle.

places.name: Maitama Medics Pharmacy
places.description: A calm, well-organised pharmacy that fills prescriptions quickly and offers free blood pressure checks.

places.name: Jabi Wellness Pharmacy
places.description: Prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines and diabetes supplies, with same-day delivery around Jabi and Utako.

places.name: Gwarinpa Family Chemist
places.description: A friendly neighbourhood chemist on 1st Avenue for everyday medicines, malaria tests and children's health.

places.name: Asokoro Pharmacy & Stores
places.description: Well stocked and well run, with a private consultation room and a strong range of imported medicines.

places.name: Garki Rx
places.description: A 24-hour pharmacy on Tafawa Balewa Way, handy for late-night prescriptions and emergency supplies.

places.name: Utako MedPoint
places.description: A compact pharmacy for everyday medicines, test kits and quick advice from the pharmacist.

places.name: Harmattan Coffee
places.description: Nigerian and Ethiopian beans roasted in small batches, plus good Wi-Fi and plenty of sockets for laptop days.

places.name: Zuma Roasters
places.description: A roastery café with a leafy courtyard. The pour-overs are excellent and the banana bread sells out by noon.

places.name: Lakeview Café
places.description: Coffee, smoothies and light bites a short walk from Jabi Lake, with outdoor tables that catch the evening breeze.

places.name: Crumbs & Kettle Bakery
places.description: A neighbourhood bakery for warm bread, meat pies and doughnuts, with strong tea and coffee to go.

places.name: Aso Brew Bar
places.description: A polished café for meetings, with espresso drinks, fresh juices and an all-day breakfast menu.

places.name: Page & Pour
places.description: A book café with shelves of Nigerian fiction, quiet reading nooks and some of the best iced lattes in town.

places.name: Sunrise Bakehouse
places.description: An early-opening bakery café for croissants, puff-puff and coffee before work.

places.name: Greenfield Supermarket
places.description: A large, well-lit supermarket with fresh produce, a butchery and an in-store bakery.

places.name: Maitama Pantry
places.description: Imported and local groceries, fine cheeses and a good wine aisle, at Maitama prices.

places.name: Jabi Daily Market
places.description: Everyday groceries, household essentials and fresh fruit at fair prices, with plenty of parking.

places.name: Gwarinpa Grocers
places.description: A dependable neighbourhood supermarket for foodstuff, toiletries and cold drinks.

places.name: Asokoro Provisions
places.description: A tidy mini-mart for fresh bread, dairy and daily essentials, with a small organic section.

places.name: Garki Value Store
places.description: Big packs of rice, oil and provisions at wholesale-style prices.

places.name: Utako Superstore
places.description: A two-floor superstore with groceries downstairs and homeware and small electronics upstairs.

places.name: Capital Iron Gym
places.description: Serious free weights, squat racks and friendly coaches. Day passes are available.

places.name: Maitama Athletic Club
places.description: A premium club with a pool, sauna, group classes and a juice bar. Members only, with guest passes.

places.name: Jabi Flow Studio
places.description: Yoga, reformer pilates and mobility classes in a sunny studio, with beginners' sessions every weekday morning.

places.name: Utako Boxing Club
places.description: Boxing classes, bag work and strength conditioning in small groups, with patient coaches for beginners.

places.name: Asokoro Wellness Centre
places.description: A calm fitness centre with modern cardio machines, a small weights room and physiotherapy on site.

places.name: CoreFit 24/7
places.description: Open all day, every day, with plenty of machines and quiet late-night sessions.

places.name: Garki Strength Lab
places.description: A no-frills strength gym with power racks, deadlift platforms and a friendly early-morning crowd.
